title: Build file-based task-packet system
businessObjective: Create durable, auditable task controls before AI OS implementation begins.
technicalObjective: Add JSON/Markdown packet templates, schemas, lifecycle tooling, and safe launcher integration.
architectureReferences: docs/architecture/source/Sri U-Thong Grand Hotel AI OS.md
assumptions: Node.js and npm remain the repository-standard cross-platform runtime.
This governance task may modify the listed shared control surfaces under the bootstrap branch.
acceptanceCriteria: All requested templates and JSON schemas exist and parse.
Task lifecycle commands enforce required execution fields and terminal immutability.
New JSON packets can be used by the Codex launcher without weakening legacy packet support.
Deterministic self-tests and package commands pass.
solEscalationTriggers: Any authorization, secret-handling, or lifecycle-integrity ambiguity.
Any change that could permit bypass of packet validation or terminal-record immutability.
rollbackExpectations: Revert only this task's committed files; do not alter legacy packets or finalized-platform reference files.
